description: This file defines the SchedulerFormValidator class, which implements validation logic for TaskDefinition objects within the OpenMRS project. It ensures required fields are present and valid, and verifies that task classes can be loaded and are proper implementations.

classes.name: SchedulerFormValidator
classes.description: A validator class for TaskDefinition objects, ensuring required fields are non-empty and that the specified task class is loadable, instantiable, and implements the Task interface.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the given class, specifically TaskDefinition.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the TaskDefinition object, including field presence, length validation, and class loading/instance checks.
